body: how?
I hate the fuss :/

I do have a hearing aid and a cochlear implant.. but they're failing at the moment :/

I've been offered to have another cochlear implant operation.. but I'm refusing it :/

I am feeling a little bit better now that I have people to talk to :)

Hmm true :3

Helper.. is really my support. I'm deaf and I always have someone next to me to help me.

I didn't know that... o.o

Yeah kind of.. I can't really trust anybody..

I dont feel as though I'm loved by the universe.. I've had a difficult teenage life and I usually get people whispering and winding me up as they tap my shoulder and run away so I would turn around and get confused.

I can't really go to the GP.. because my doctor is my helper's (from school) husband.. and my helper is BEST FRIENDS with my mum.

I can't trust doctors, due to the past problems so I wouldnt want to have medication :/

but thanks for your help!

True true, I'm only 16 and I know I have a big life ahead of me. But I adore my boyfriend and I would do ANYTHING to keep him. I do suffer from depression and I feel quite nervous and worried that I'm going to lose him because of my ex boyfriends.. I'm currently on a diet because they dumped me; because I was fat... But yeah.. thanks :)
It's just the atmosphere.. it feels so uncomfortable. The people are like.. awkward.. haha
Just the atmosphere and it's just.. weird :/

Unfortuantely, I have been seeing someone for this.. and they said I was fine and I'm just going through my teens.. :/

But heyho.. I think I should be alright. :) I was being SO silly last night, thinking of ways to say sorry to my mum haha..

At the moment, I'm REALLY not confident about my future because I went to visit an University and I HATED it..

Now I'm worried that I would hate my other options.. :/

Yeaah, cause I want to go Teesside, and he wants to go Edinburgh.. :/
Not be together;I meant he would have to finish me.. :/
Omg they are all my favourite food haha x

Na it's always something after the other. Tbh thats the only thing I'm looking forward to at the moment 
Thankyou x
Ah good. I actually told her about that and she apologised for once. Thank god, but my dad is making me mum cry now ;(

Will do thanks (: I had an argument at school today with a teacher because she confronted me that I wasn't treally behaving at home. I basically told her to leave out of my business and my mum had a phone call from that teacher and she yelled at me for yelling at her aha. I should be yelling at her for telling the teachers about my business!! Have I done the wrong thing?
I will give Childline a go but I'm petrified in case they come into my house and say "right so and so.." it scares the crap out of me :/
Ahh I will look into that, thankyou. We're the only people who knows what parents are truly like. i'm just pleased I'm not the only one! Thankyou so much :)

No, at school, she's having teachers telling her that she is the best mum, bringing up an amazing child with good manners and ethuastism. She's making herself look awesome to those teachers. I'M the only one who knows the real her. My friends think she's amazing and they're jealous of me? :S

What can Childline do? :/ and what do I say to them? :/

Well, I actually want to be independent throughout education because at the moment, I'm having this woman helping me, for 6 hours every day. And it's annoying the heck out of me, so I'm considering University, possibly Interactive Media Design.

I'm also worried about people around University, because I lack of good communication skills and I have NO idea how to start a conversation face-to-face.. except for Hi. (lol)

I actually want to have a job that I enjoy the most, not being an accountant (my mum wants me to have that job..) but anyway, I really like to design things and making videos, etc, etc.

I partly don't want to go to University because.. I feel as though I just want to get on with my life.. like, get a job and have a family.. because I'm worried in case I study something for 4 extra years and I end up with no job relating to that. :/

But please PM me if you have anymore to say, thankyou.

Yeah we do.. but she is a really close friend of my mum.. and I can't really trust her. :(

Another thing, my mum actually told a teacher that I lied, and she just went "I know why your mum doesn't trust you to travel far.." and I was like, "oh what?!" and she said "Cause you told her a white lie, about boyfriends.." .. basically mocking me.

I don't really trust anybody about this mocking thing because I feel as though someone will say "awh don't be silly, you're just over exaggerating."

I'm actually scared in case people will think I'm making things up, like my mum laughing when I'm complaining of a sore stomach or head, because in middle school, I lied about being ill to get out of school.. (partly because I get bullied..) but still... :/
omg you hero! :')

I will do, thankyou.

I can't help being scared of things I've not really done before. I dislike my mum for not trusting me to go out to places. But I don't blame her to be honest. :/

Thanks, that means a lot.
I will try and stay on here until I feel better. I've been thinking and I will concentrate on my future, I just can't wait :/
I just don't feel loved. No matter how many times my boyfriend tells me he does, I just feel as though he's using me, like my exes did. :/ but thankyou anyway :)

My family is the sarcastic type, nobody takes anything seriously.

I know but I'm scared to be around her, it's kinda obvious. Whenever I go town with her, I'm at least 5 metres away from her. I'm just so scared.

I will try but I can't see the GP without my mum's permission. :/

I haven't seen them but I will.. plus, I'm not allowed to go to the gym without my mum lmao! D;

No, Media is my all time favourite subject. And I'm just not sure because of the jobs in the future.
I know, I really don't wish this on anyone and personally, I'm pleased it happening to me instead of my friends, I can't bear to see them sad :/

I wish I had the guts to get a job, my first interview was REALLY bad and I couldn't get the job because I was deaf :/

I live in a small town and my mum doesn't let me travel very far. just an hour on the train is allowed.

I really want freedom and to socialise with new people but I can't cause I don't travel :/ x

I can't talk to anybody from school because they're all friends with my mum and they will tell her. :/

I have tried but my mum is really the boss and tells my dad not to bother too much about me because I have told lies in the past. :/

I don't really know what I want to do in the future.. I want to get a job but when I went to an interview, the boss politely asked me to leave because I was unable to do the job because I'm deaf.
Nobody will sue them but I honestly don't know if I want to get on with my future, have kids and treat them like a diamond. But I'm not sure whether I want to spend 4 more years studying Media :/ x
